integrity: Complete analytic proof and a standalone standard-library diagnostic checker; computations are supporting, not a surrogate for infinite theorems.
scientific_limitations: Normal infinitesimal derivative along the invariant predator-free axis under the stationary logistic invariant measure; the signed multiplier cannot establish positivity or nonlinear predator persistence/extinction. The standard derivative special case was previously obtained by Anteneodo. Unindexed equivalent displaced-zero calculations remain a priority risk.
title: Exact transverse-log covariance spectrum on the chaotic axis of a coupled logistic population map
